note: The polyemesis Streamer.bot pack: every action it ships, and the one REST call each makes. Polyemesis.cs implements exactly these; internal/api/streamerbot_pack_test.go replays each against the real router with a token of the scope named here, and checks Polyemesis.cs calls no path that is not listed. {destinationId} and {track} are Streamer.bot arguments; {source} is the optional polyemesisSource global.

actions.name: polyemesis: Go live (start all)
actions.description: Starts every destination on the programme, paced two seconds apart. The same as Start all in the console.

actions.name: polyemesis: Stop all
actions.description: Stops every destination on the programme. ENDS ANY LIVE YOUTUBE BROADCAST PERMANENTLY; starting again does not bring it back.

actions.name: polyemesis: Start destination
actions.description: Starts one destination. Set the destinationId argument.

actions.name: polyemesis: Stop destination
actions.description: Stops one destination. Ends its YouTube broadcast if it has one.

actions.name: polyemesis: Mute track
actions.description: Mutes one audio track on one destination, live. track is 0-based: OBS track 1 is 0.

actions.name: polyemesis: Unmute track
actions.description: Unmutes one audio track on one destination, live.

actions.name: polyemesis: Status to chat
actions.description: Reads the destinations and sets %polyemesisLive% (how many are running) and %polyemesisSummary% for a following Send Message sub-action.
